entries.4c5558856f216deb: A knitting machine manufacturer with its head office and head office plant in Wakayama City, Wakayama Prefecture, the company and 12 consolidated subsidiaries form the group. Flat knitting machines, design systems, and glove and sock knitting machines and their parts are manufactured at the head office plant, and are sold in Japan by the company and overseas through local sales subsidiaries and others. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, consolidated revenue was ¥33,509 million and consolidated employees numbered 1,654; the company is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.556b422bd7772703: This is the core business, manufacturing and selling computerized flat knitting machines and semi-Jacquard flat knitting machines. It operates mainly with WHOLEGARMENT (fully seamless) flat knitting machines, which knit sweaters and other garments in one piece without seams. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,866 million.
